# --- Adaptive FAMD function with column drop ---
def run_famd_adaptive_drop(X, filename, var_threshold=0.95, max_components=None):
    # Drop columns specific to this file
    drop_cols = DROP_COLS_MAP.get(filename, [])
    X = X.drop(columns=[col for col in drop_cols if col in X.columns], errors='ignore')

    # --- Standard FAMD preprocessing ---
    # Parse datetime columns
    for col in X.columns:
        if X[col].dtype == "object":
            try:
                X[col] = pd.to_datetime(X[col])
            except:
                pass

    for col in X.select_dtypes(include="datetime"):
        X[col + "_year"] = X[col].dt.year
        X[col + "_month"] = X[col].dt.month
        X[col + "_day"] = X[col].dt.day
        X = X.drop(columns=col)

    X_num = X.select_dtypes(include="number").fillna(X.select_dtypes(include="number").mean())
    X_cat = X.select_dtypes(exclude="number").astype("category").fillna("Missing")
    X_clean = pd.concat([X_num, X_cat], axis=1)

    if max_components is None:
        max_components = min(X_clean.shape)

    famd = prince.FAMD(n_components=max_components, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    X_famd = famd.fit_transform(X_clean)

    cumvar = np.cumsum(famd.eigenvalues_ / famd.eigenvalues_.sum())
    n_components_opt = np.searchsorted(cumvar, var_threshold) + 1

    if n_components_opt < max_components:
        famd = prince.FAMD(n_components=n_components_opt, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
        X_famd = famd.fit_transform(X_clean)

    return X_famd, famd, n_components_opt, cumvar

# --- Scree plot ---
def famd_scree_plot(famd, cumvar, title=None):
    plt.plot(cumvar, marker="o")
    plt.xlabel("Number of Components")
    plt.ylabel("Cumulative Explained Variance")
    if title:
        plt.title(title)
    plt.show()

# --- Wrapper for CSV files ---
def famd_from_csv_drop(filepath, var_threshold=0.95):
    X = pd.read_csv(filepath)
    filename = os.path.basename(filepath)
    print(filename)
    try:
        X_famd, famd, n_components_opt, cumvar = run_famd_adaptive_drop(X, filename, var_threshold)
        print(f"Optimal components for {var_threshold*100:.0f}% variance: {n_components_opt}")
        print("Explained variance ratio:")
        print(famd.eigenvalues_ / famd.eigenvalues_.sum())
        famd_scree_plot(famd, cumvar, title=filename)
        return X_famd, famd
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Skipping {filename}: {e}")
        return None
